dismissed_comment: Reviewed sanitizer safeReturnPath permits only local route prefixes; javascript/data schemes cannot reach location.assign. web/tests/auth-navigation.test.ts verifies same HTTPS origin for both locales and malicious inputs. No HTML/script evaluation occurs here.

safeReturnPath accepts only allowlisted local paths and rejects backslashes/control chars. New web/tests/auth-navigation.test.ts checks URL parser origin and protocol for malicious schemes, encoded slashes, dot segments and both locales. All 48 Web tests pass.

signValue HMAC-signs a server-created session payload (user id, exp, version), not a password. Password storage uses salted scrypt in hashPassword/verifyPassword. Auth/OAuth e2e pass. Full source review recorded in Audit v1.1 follow-up report.

SHA-1 only derives stable session IDs from public openclawAgent/kind/threadId fields; it does not hash tokens/passwords or authorize access. buildSessionKey excludes accessToken. Keeping this non-security identifier preserves existing conversation history.
